title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 501 South Kirkman Road in Orlando, Florida, as the "Napoleon 'Nap' Ford Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 501 South Kirkman Road in Orlando, Florida, as the "Napoleon 'Nap' Ford Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Postal Service building in Orlando, Florida, after Napoleon "Nap" Ford.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 501 South Kirkman Road in Orlando, Florida, as the "Napoleon 'Nap' Ford Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
